title: Signature Open Bench Frame — Why the Frame exists

title: Signature Open Bench Frame — Extrusion everything
description: The entire Frame is slotted aluminum extrusion, so mounts slide to any position and lock with a quarter turn. A new form factor does not need a new bench — it needs thirty seconds with an Allen key.
